In his name, the nations will hope.”

In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
translations.bsb: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
translations.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
translations.asv: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
